description: This Java class provides utility methods for constructing image file paths for different content types (product images, manufacturer images, store logos, etc.) within an e-commerce web application. It uses constants and object properties to generate standardized file paths.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for generating image file paths for various content types in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for static content images based on store and image name.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for manufacturer images based on store, manufacturer, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for product images based on store, product, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath (overload with sku)
methods.description: Constructs the file path for product images based on store, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for large product images based on store, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for store logo images.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for product property images based on store and image name.
